messages:
ops-bot: ALERT: pool=dedicated-eu1 token-latency spike observed (p50 ~800ms). autoscaler attempt failed due to ephemeral-quota guard. paging oncall: @Sara K.
Sara K.: taking pager. grabbing the mitigation runbook now. quick sanity: which customers driving this?
Miguel R.: were seeing two large sustained flows: cust-42 and cust-77. parallel streams exploded ~2x in last 2m.
Sara K.: tl;dr objective: keep paid Dedicated latency <300ms. mitigation plan: 1) enable manual burst for dedicated-eu1 2) apply soft per-customer rate caps to the heavy hitters 3) route a small canary to eu1-b replica 4) inform CS/AE.
Priya S.: enabling burst (manual) now. running:
```
rictl pools set-burst --pool dedicated-eu1 --mode manual --burst-tokens 20000
```
Priya S.: burst enabled, provisioning +3 nodes (ephemeral). ETA ~40s.
Evan L.: adding a traffic slice to cap heavy customers to 30% of pool capacity:
```
routingctl add-slice --pool dedicated-eu1 --match "customer_id in (cust-42,cust-77)" --name heavy --weight 0.3
```
Miguel R.: slice in place; slice hit ~0.29 for both customers. traffic shaping reducing overall saturation.
Sara K.: applying short soft quota to cust-77 to blunt spikes (15m window):
```
quotactl set --customer cust-77 --rate 40 --type soft --ttl 15m
```
Dan P.: notifying CS/AE: "cust-77 may experience reduced throughput for ~15m while infra mitigates" -> pinged #customer-success and AEs.
ops-bot: autoscaler event: manual-burst-allowed -> nodes provisioning. pool capacity +3 GPUs (expected).
Priya S.: note: earlier autoscaler failed because the quota controller rejected ephemeral > account limit. I increased ephemeral allowance for the pool and re-triggered:
```
quotactl adjust --scope pool:dedicated-eu1 --ephemeral 3
```
Miguel R.: tailing logs: seeing some 429s hitting cust-77 (soft cap), but no large 5xx cascade. p50 dropped to ~220ms, p90 ~480ms. KV cache miss rate still elevated, investigating hotspot prefixes.
Sara K.: good containment so far. plan to keep burst on until 10:05 UTC, extend quotas if needed, and discuss per-customer autoscale exemptions in postmortem. tagging @product for follow up.
Dan P.: creating incident ticket INC-2026-185001 and adding initial timeline + link to metrics dash: https://metrics/redwood/incidents/1850013912
Sara K.: I'll handoff to @Miguel R. in 20m for watch. if anything regresses, re-page oncall. please keep CS looped.
Miguel R.: ack, taking watch. will monitor p50/p95, slice hitrate, and any 5xx/429 spikes. will escalate if regression.
ops-bot: Incident state: mitigation_active -> watch. linked logs: https://logs.redwood/pool/dedicated-eu1/3912345670
Sara K.: thanks team. postmortem owners: Dan (doc), Miguel (infra), Priya (runbook changes). will collect snapshot of quota configs and routing rules before turning burst off.
